text:
Linda - Support: heads up — seeing a sudden cluster of 502/504 and timeout reports hitting /v1/generate (hosted). multiple customer tickets (2451,2452,2455). some apps surface "payment processing failed" errors when the API times out. creating this thread to coordinate. :rotating_light:
Isabela - Oncall: i'm on it. can folks drop any recent deploys, config changes, or autoscaler tweaks? need request ids and example traces.
Ajay - Eng: i merged an autoscaler change earlier today (commit a1b2c3f) that bumped edge-proxy max_concurrency 80->120 and adjusted burst window. rolled at ~1749994000. might be related to connection pooling behavior.
deploy-bot: deploy started by @ajay (commit a1b2c3f) — edge-proxy-autoscaler — rollout id r-2024-09-14-03
Simon - SRE: digging into gateway logs. seeing many upstream timeouts from inference-proxy with repeated 504s. sample log: ```[edge-proxy] upstream_timeout id=req-8f7a path=/v1/generate upstream=inference-proxy:504 latency=10.12s``` looks like kv-cache stall + connection exhaustion to inference pool.
Ajay - Eng: kv-cache change? i didn't touch kv-cache. recent model-serving change (quantization warmup) rolled on dedicated nodes but not hosted. could be autoscaler causing higher concurrency on edge which exposes a latent kv-cache race.
Isabela - Oncall: collecting traces now. Is there a way to force degrade to a lower-concurrency route for hosted while we triage?
Simon - SRE: added a temporary routing rule to cap concurrency per route to 50 and enabled fallback to model-variant small-1. Should reduce pressure. i've left the rule in for now. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: created incident incident-1749997777, paging oncall and eng.
Megan - Customer Success: i spoke with customer A — they saw repeated client-side billing failures when the API returned 502s. offered temporary credits and they asked for ETA. we need a short customer-facing note.
Linda - Support: can we confirm mitigation success? any visible drop in 5xx?
Simon - SRE: after the cap, 5xx rate dropped ~80% in the last 6m on affected clusters. still seeing occasional 5xxs correlated with long tail KV GET latency (200-400ms -> spikes).
Ajay - Eng: plan: 1) revert the autoscaler burst window change (owner: ajay, target: 1749998200) 2) add circuit-breaker on kv-cache reads in inference-proxy (owner: ajay/sre pair, timeline: 24h) 3) immediate config to enforce per-connection keepalive and reduce pool churn (owner: simon, target: 1749998100).
Isabela - Oncall: recording action items in incident tracker. will keep routing cap for next 1h and then evaluate.
Megan - Customer Success: i'll draft a short customer note: "We detected elevated timeouts impacting some requests to /v1/generate, mitigation applied, engineers reverting an autoscaler change and hardening cache reads. We'll follow up with RCA."
Linda - Support: thanks. postmortem owners?
Ajay - Eng: i'll own RCA and remediation write-up (RCA-doc link will be posted here).
Simon - SRE: i'll follow-up on long-term SRE tasks (connection pool redesign + observability for kv-cache tail latency).
Isabela - Oncall: summary for handback: mitigation applied (route cap + fallback), rollback of autoscaler in progress, monitoring baseline restored to normal for now. handing off to daytime (isabela -> ajay/simon).
Linda - Support: assigning customer comms and credits to me and megan. closing war-room, moving to postmortem thread. thanks all. :pray:
